main_text.l: Vulgus subtrahit à dextra versus sinistrā:
At nonnulli à sinistra versus dextram sub-
trahere solent: quem ordinem nos seruabi-
mus. Numerus major primum scribat: de-
supra ponito, quod si nihil relictum fue-
rit, præcedente aliqua nota, scribito o.
serit, huic præponito unum supra mente
reservatum, aut unum à præcedente supra
posito numero detractum : atq; tum dedu-
ros : Et solvi 6545, sexies millenos quin-
Et dico 6 à 7 remanet unum, quod se-
quenti subtrahendæ notæ, à qua inferior

page.notes: Page is clean. The two-line sum is printed with the 6 of the subtrahend set high; it is copied here at the same level. The catchword "sub-" is printed at the lower right.
